acceptance_criteria.requirement: Settings uses one header, 152 px rail, active-page scroller, optional shared PreviewDock, and final-row footer at every width.
The window defaults to 1200x800, enforces 1040x700 when the screen permits, clamps restored size, centers a maximum-1240 inner shell, and uses the same dock in the small-screen overlay fallback.
Section and Full dashboard render through the production renderer; Fit scales top-aligned without clipping and 100 percent owns the preview secondary scrollbar.
All four pages are captured at 1040, 1200, and full-screen widths at 100 and 150 percent application fonts.
Revert, Close, Save changes, and the inline save-error region remain reachable in stable final-row positions.
Events proves empty, populated, selected, searched, and archived states with legible two-line rows, one context-appropriate Add event CTA, and selected-event calendar preview.
Bible proves short, long, and custom verses with reference/excerpt rows, Current and Preview badges, separate selection and rotation, and incremental loading.
About proves side-by-side Version and Help, compact privacy/legal disclosures, byte-exact Scripture attribution, and complete Backup and recovery content.
Dirty, revert, successful save, inline failure, legacy Calendar routing, restored/clamped window size, and controlled restart are proven without persisting Preview visibility.
Font-relative targets grow naturally at 150 percent without an alternate layout tree or clipped text.
The transparent root remains in normal flow at max 1120 px with 24 px top and 20 px side minimums and no root viewport-height or overflow clipping.

A visible fixed or sticky bottom-action container is detected without localized button text and drives root padding and document scroll padding by measured height plus 24 px; 60 px is fallback height only.
Month and Year reuse one 24 px title and compact 34 px control header that wraps naturally without hiding controls.
Month always renders a 42-cell six-week grid and retains independently visible completion, selection, today, due, and event cues.
Year keeps one real 53-week tree with 28 px weekday column, 10-12 px cells, 3 px gaps, and horizontal scrolling only when it physically cannot fit.
Legend and date/event summary are compact and conditional while browsing, editing, adding, tooltips, date selection, and Most Missed remain intact.
Every theme-specific saved palette ID has separately authored and visually distinct light and dark completion ladders while IDs and selections stay unchanged.
White, black, purple, and image hosts preserve Anki chrome and remain legible without repainting the host.
Production and 100 percent preview render the configured verse font, size, and color exactly; Fit scales that same component.
Schema remains 8 and name sorting is case-insensitive by name, then date and stable ID; ascending and descending retain date semantics.
Config and manual verse writes are prepared before mutation, previous config and bytes are retained, and a partial failure attempts rollback before a specific inline error.
The reproducible 1.8.5 archive passes its allowlist, safe-path, byte-parity, manifest/assets, secret/link, and exact-installed-hash gates.
Fresh and restarted Anki 26.8 runs prove process, window, filesystem, and sync isolation before interaction.
VoiceOver, Windows, Linux, forced colors, DPR 1, and OS display scaling remain explicitly unrun unless separately executed.
